entities.name: Margarita Zavala de Calderón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Margarita Ester Zavala Gómez del Campo is a Mexican politician and lawyer. She has served as a member of the Chamber of Deputies representing Mexico City's 10th electoral district since 2021. As the wife of Felipe Calderón, she was the first lady of Mexico from 2006 to 2012. An independent politician, Zavala was a candidate in the 2018 Mexican presidential election, running from 12 October 2017, until withdrawing on 16 May 2018.
